title: Learn Arabic, one step at a time
tagline: Start with the alphabet, then branch into Quranic Arabic, Modern Standard Arabic, and everyday spoken Arabic. Every lesson's words feed your daily review deck.

tracks.title: Foundations
tracks.description: The alphabet, vowel marks, and reading your first words. Start here.

lessons.title: The Alphabet
lessons.summary: All 28 letters, their names, sounds, and joined forms.

lessons.title: Short Vowels (Harakat)
lessons.summary: Fatha, kasra, damma, sukun, shadda, and tanween.

lessons.title: Long Vowels & First Words
lessons.summary: Stretching vowels with ا و ي and reading real words.

tracks.title: Quranic Arabic
tracks.description: Understand what you recite, starting with the words that appear most often.

lessons.title: Al-Fatiha, Word by Word
lessons.summary: Every word of the opening surah and what it means.

lessons.title: High-Frequency Quranic Words
lessons.summary: Small words that unlock a large share of the Quran.

tracks.title: Modern Standard Arabic
tracks.description: The formal Arabic of books, news, and writing across the Arab world.

lessons.title: Greetings & Introductions
lessons.summary: Saying hello, asking how someone is, and introducing yourself.

lessons.title: Nouns, Gender & “the”
lessons.summary: The definite article ال, sun and moon letters, and feminine ة.

tracks.title: Spoken Arabic (Egyptian)
tracks.description: Everyday conversational Arabic. Egyptian is the most widely understood dialect.

lessons.title: Everyday Phrases
lessons.summary: The small words you'll hear in every conversation.
